name: Java: 1Z0-830 Java SE 21 Developer Professional (Oracle)
material_vintage: Oracle University 1Z0-830 Java SE 21 Developer Professional exam topics, fetched live on 2026-09-26 from the Oracle MyLearn exam page and itemised in full: every listed objective in the ten areas, plus the three 'Candidates are also expected to' objectives, is one item. Exam format as published: proctored online; multiple choice; 50 questions; 120 minutes; passing score 68%. Oracle publishes no area weights and no past papers: every item here is original. Exam-dump sites were not used. Every code-output answer key was generated by compiling and running the code on JDK 21; the module and jar commands in S15 were run for real on JDK 21 while authoring.
level_source: standalone: a vendor certification with no RQF/FHEQ level

learner_notices.text: 1Z0-830 is a professional-level exam and much harder than 1Z0-811: expect code-reading items where the answer is 'does not compile'. The course therefore marks exact compile and runtime outcomes strictly.
